responsibility: Implements GCC’s main compiler driver: the command-line orchestrator that decodes options, expands specs, constructs tool invocations, manages temporary files and environment changes, prepares input/output sets, selects languages and compilation stages, and optionally runs the linker and collect2/LTO helpers. It owns the reusable driver class, spec processing infrastructure, path and multilib setup, diagnostic/reporting flow, jobserver and environment coordination, and finalization logic that resets global driver state so the driver can also be rerun safely in-process by other clients.
same_name_distinction: This is the core implementation file of the gcc driver pair: it contains the driver class methods, spec processing, environment management, command orchestration, temporary-file handling, and state reset logic. Unlike gcc/gcc.h, it is the executable driver engine, not the declaration surface used by code that links against it.
